description:
The 2023 Seventh-Day Adventist General Conference Annual Council convened earlier this week where SDA Worldwide Church president Ted Wilson gave his annual address. 

From mentioning those of us who criticize their movement as being weird people online to claiming they simply believe the Bible as it reads, Wilson's state of the union style address provides a perfect example for us to, not only respond to some of his claims about us, but also to show Christians how the Great Controversy Theme filters and clouds all of SDA thinking.

📺 Become A MEMBER & Get Exclusive Content: https://linke.to/FGAj 
💰 DONATE & SUPPORT our Ministry: https://givebutter.com/3hpgqk

✏️ SHARE your testimony: https://linke.to/NEyH
